As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

190021.description:
Woo-Yeon (27) has been dedicated to the company for 7 years, but is passed over for promotion because he is a high school graduate. He postpones cleaning with the excuse of working overtime, and his one-room apartment becomes a garbage dump. Woo-Yeon, who has become lethargic due to the fatigue and stress of the past, cannot get up from the garbage dump. Until a strange woman, Ha-Ra (28), comes and cleans the garbage dump... What is her true identity?

(Source: Naver, translated)

190022.description:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others’ emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel. Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light. When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever he calls. Jenna agrees, but with one condition—he must appear in the form of a snow leopard whenever they're together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A completely ordinary young man named Souichirou works as a repairman. One day, while lost in the mountains, he is saved by a mysterious man. This man, who kisses Souichirou’s hand without warning and even flies through the air, possesses otherworldly powers.

To repay him for his help, Souichirou ventures back into the mountains. However, after meeting the man several times, he eventually finds that the man has lost his memory...?

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Falsely accused of treason and cast out from his noble lineage, Do-hwa finds himself with nowhere to turn—except to his childhood friend, Sung-mook. To protect him, Sung-mook offers shelter...by disguising Do-hwa as his personal concubine. But the ruse doesn’t end with just makeup and dresses. To keep up appearances, Sung-mook insists Do-hwa serve him in the bedroom, too. What starts as merely an act turns into something far more complicated...and far more intimate. For when desire and deception collide, who’s really in control?

190043.description:
The Heavenly Black Bird descended, giving rise to the Great Shang. Emperor Xin, the descendant of the Black Bird, ascended as the ruler of the Great Shang, shouldering its destiny. He mastered martial arts effortlessly and conquered the world swiftly. However, just as Emperor Xin conquered Xiqi, feeling accomplished and even a little bored, he suddenly found himself transported to the modern world—he had time-traveled! Discovering a startling fact, he realized he was a character from a novel in this world!

(Source: Webnovel)

190046.description:
Defeated in war, Geon-Mu, a former emperor, loses all power and is taken as a prisoner by the enemy nation. Stripped of dignity and freedom, he is forced to become the personal plaything of the beautiful yet merciless, Yeon-Hwa. Yeon-Hwa, who once forcefully claimed Geon-Mu’s body, now seeks to control every aspect of his life—his movements, his thoughts, even his emotions. And yet, each night, the emperor weeps, asking if Geon-Mu has truly forgotten him, whispering confessions of love through trembling lips.

“Your Majesty... you are beautiful.”

But Geon-Mu can no longer tell if the turmoil in his heart is hatred or something far more dangerous. As the line between enemy and lover begins to blur, Geon-Mu is left questioning: Is this agony the product of betrayal… or the weight of a love that should never have existed?

(Source: Lezhin US)

190047.description:
In the prestigious Lee family, only Alphas are ever born—and 8-year-old Lee Mun-Ho is no exception. So when he's suddenly married off to Han Wol-Ah, the elegant 16-year-old heir of the famous Omega Han family, it's the talk of the town. At the wedding, poor Mun-Ho is a bundle of nerves… until Wol-Ah gently calms him down. Cue instant puppy-love. But the moment the ceremony ends? Prince Charming disappears. “Massage my legs,” Wol-Ah commands. And just like that, Mun-Ho’s honeymoon becomes housework. From that day on, Wol-Ah treats him less like a groom and more like a very tiny servant. Years pass in comedic misery until finally—Mun-Ho’s coming-of-age ceremony arrives. He’s taller. Stronger. Still hopelessly in love. But now the tables might just turn...

Will Mun-Ho get revenge? Or will he fall even harder for the bossy Omega who stole his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

190049.description:
All he wanted was to get wrecked by a hung, handsome octoman... San-Ho’s been pouring his deepest desires into octopus fishing (literally), so when he saves the Dragon King's octopus prince and lands and lands an invite to the palace, the first thing he asks for is his very own beastman husband. But instead of the massive, tentacled stud he imagined, he gets Baek-Kyung. No tentacles, no monster size... just a cute, compact little guy. He wanted calamari. He got shrimp. But hey… sometimes small packages pack a big punch.

(Source: Lezhin US)

190051.description:
Middle school life isn’t all fun and games for an art club girl either! From club activities to studying, games to manga, hobbies, BL, and “mufufu” fantasies...or even...love?! Uchida is a member of the art club. She’s got a lot of strange obsessions and she’s not great at dealing with people. A short candid manga about the ups and downs of school life with the classmates surrounding her and the adolescent boy who sits next to her.

(Source: Light Reason, translated)

190052.description:
The young master of flames, Yeom-Ju, carries a rare blue fire—one that once scorched the heart of his beloved teacher, Ban-Ui, the very man who first taught him what love meant. Ban-Ui, cursed with immortality as punishment for sins in a past life, cannot die no matter how deeply he longs for release. Wracked with guilt over Yeom-Ju’s pain, he disappears without a trace, hoping distance will lessen the burden for them both. But Yeom-Ju, unwilling to let go, chooses to walk through his own personal hell to find him again. Years of longing, suffering, and searching finally lead him to Ban-Ui once more. Even now, the fire within Yeom-Ju still burns only for him. But will Ban-Ui allow himself to be found… or is the wound between them too deep to heal?

Some flames never fade. Some love never dies.

(Source: Lezhin US)

190053.description:
Hong Si-won, the greatest chef in Korean history, suddenly passed away. His last will was shocking: all the chefs in his restaurant were to compete for the position of head chef. A young man with a “divine tongue,” Park Geon-woo, is invited to this fierce competition. Can he survive the intense battlefield of “Tae Mi-ok” where no one can be trusted? A heated culinary showdown filled with passion, growth, friendship, and conflict. Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

(Source: Naver, translated)

190055.description:
In South Korea, where the juvenile law has been abolished and rehabilitation centers for juvenile offenders have been established, Min-su, who has been wrongfully accused of murder and sent to a rehabilitation center, realizes that it is a hell from which he can never escape through normal means. Min-su's older brother, Yu-seong, infiltrates the rehabilitation center as a guard to save his brother in crisis... A desperate struggle for survival and escape unfolds as the two brothers fight against false justice!

He has no idea who inhabits the suit, only that the soothing hug seems to relieve him of the pressures of everyday life. But after so many visits, he starts to get curious: who is the person inside?! Will knowing who they are ruin his reputation as the perfect student council president, or could this be the start of a totally new relationship? Grab a lilypad and jump into this adorable manga about two total opposites!

190211.description:
"Please divorce me!" Iris is dejected after her engagement is suddenly broken off. Then she receives a marriage proposal from Wolf, a knight feared as the "Ice Wolf." Though confused, Iris decides to marry him, believing it is the duty of a woman born into nobility, but Wolf, who is as intimidating as the rumors say, coldly rejects her. What's more, Wolf leaves home to fight a war soon after their marriage...

Iris continues to wait for him, enduring the gossip of the servants. "If I carry on like this, I won't be able to fulfill my duties as a wife, and I'll be a nuisance to Wolf," Iris worries, and finally asks Wolf for a divorce. Then his attitude changes completely--!?

A love story between a clumsy, devoted knight and a brave heroine, guided by a ring of destiny!

The manga follows a country girl named Suzu who transfers to a middle school in the big city. When she suddenly has a stomachache, she runs to the infirmary. There she meets an overly enthusiastic doctor who appears to be a cat.

(Source: Anime News Network)

190223.description:
Fujiyoshi Murasaki, a first-year high school girl, transfers to an all-boys school, hiding her gender. The reason for transferring is to be able to keep a closer eye on two handsome guys who are her "favorite couple" that she saw on the train one day. In order to enjoy her fujoshi life for the fullest during her three years of high school, Murasaki approaches them in an attempt to become friends with them.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

190224.description:
I am a single, middle-aged man who leads a normal, stable life running my own dental clinic. After finishing my morning appointments, I was glad to see the cute, devilish girl who came into my clinic in the late afternoon.

She asks me, "Hey, do you have someone you like? Do you know anything about uncle-niece marriages?"

The girl is my niece, Koyune, a college student. Her eyes are teasing. Her attitude is bold and sometimes lewd. No, no, no… for me, Koyune is just my cute niece. Nothing more or less than that...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

190228.description:
Japan has experienced an "influx" of demi-humans. Nina, a centaur girl who is the first demi-human police officer in Tokyo, meets a man named Yuri, a former police officer known as "No. 0."

(Source: Comic Growl, translated)

190229.description:
Chinese traditional fashion will connect the lives of two young women across the millenia.

One day, Bai Tang, a freshman in university, accidentally "picked up" a girl named Zhu Lian, a girl dressed in Tang-dynasty attire who claims to have come from more a thousand years ago... From the moment she met Zhu Liang, Bai Tang's ordinary life takes a wild turn.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Gosh! I'm blackmailed by an antique? The paperweight I bought is actually a monster? He says he belongs to the emperor even when his parts are not complete? I think he is just a mud monster. Well, does anyone want him? A little bit of money is enough.

Waking up in the world of “Love and Pandora”, a trashy otome mobile game set on the Pandora Continent, the main character found that she had transmigrated as the renowned villainess of the game, Medea, the queen who would be executed in the future. To change her fate, she decided not to cross paths with the male leads, or the original female lead of the game. Unbeknownst to her, however, all the male leads were revived with their memories of their past lives, and they felt deep guilt towards Medea. On the other hand, Freya, the original female lead of the game, noticed Medea and started romancing her as well…

(Source: Webnovel)

But after his normal part-time job closes down, Jun-Woo desperately signs up for all the lucrative one-day gigs he can find. Little does he know, money won't be the only thing he gets from these quick and easy jobs. Will Jun-Woo be able to see his beloved twins play football? Or will his seven wildly different jobs leave an undeniable mark on his body?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Bo-yeong and Haewon have been dating for ten years since they met at university. The two have been through thick and thin together, supporting each other every step of the way. But at some point, their relationship began to feel strained. They thought they knew each other better than anyone after a decade together. But they're starting to realize that as time passes, it's becoming increasingly difficult for them to understand each other.

A seductive romance fantasy between a shrine maiden and the most fearsome fox spirit. Ritsu comes from a family of exorcists who seal away spirits, but she's too softhearted to do the job right... One day, she accidentally breaks the seal of a vicious fox spirit named Byakuya...!? Will she be devoured… or simply played with? The clash between a hopeless exorcist and a mischievous fox spirit begins!

Being the owner of a dungeon is the best dream a demon could have. So when Succubus Adelaide inherits one from an unknown grandfather, she believes she’s set for life. Unfortunately, her inheritance comes with an enormous amount of debt, and she’ll have to raise the dungeon’s rank from F-class to S-class if she has any hope of paying it back. But all that hard work will be worth it because Adelaide will soon be owning much more than just a dungeon as the mistress of three men who beg for the succubus’s attention...!

190250.description:
At the high school attended by Raito Shirai, the school’s most beautiful girl, Misaki Kuroyuki, receives love confessions every few days. These confession scenes have become something of a regular event—but Misaki continues to turn down every single one.

Raito, who sees himself as an unpopular loner, watches her from afar, convinced that they live in completely different worlds. However, during a visit to a festival with his younger sister, he runs into Misaki being harassed by some troublesome guys. With no other option, he pretends to be her boyfriend to get her out of the situation.

Unfortunately, their act is witnessed by other students from their school, and the rumor spreads like wildfire. Then, Misaki herself asks Raito to keep pretending to be her boyfriend—because it’s just convenient in many ways.

It’s a fake relationship, but sweeter and more frustrating than the real thing... And so begins the story of a pretend couple in this romantic comedy!

(Source: Dash X Bunko, translated)

Aiku, a girl who is new to love and attends an all-girls school, suddenly ends up going on a date with a handsome stranger! A pure love comedy♡

190258.description:
A noble lady unwanted by her family. A prince unwanted by his country. There was a reason why they gravitated toward each other. Andrea always dreamed of Prince Charming coming to her rescue. And she thought she found him in Kahir--the abandoned Prince of Ragenia. But when her stepsister schemes to marry her off to an old and perverted marquis, Andrea decides to take advantage of his love by seducing Kahir and asking him to run away with her. Believing her words, Kahir does away with the dirty marquis. However, his love for Andrea turns into hatred he realizes that she had used him to escape the unwanted marriage. Andrea soon regrets her actions, but Kahir wants nothing of her. Will the star-crossed lovers be able to find their happy ending?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

"We finally meet again." Lady Liliana looks back at her memories with her childhood friend often. But when she is summoned to the royal palace for suspected tax evasion, she comes face to face with her friend once again after so many years. But wait. He is the King?! Psychometry is the ability to read the memories contained in an item. Kang Min-Woo has been blessed, or cursed, with this ability. Though only a high school student, he's been tapped by police detective Lee Aran to use his ability to help solve cases. In exchange, Detective Lee will help him settle a score of his own. The job is bearable, until one blood-chilling murder case leads them into a world of violence, madness, kidnapping, and cults that strikes a little too close to home for Minwoo.

With that in mind, she registers at a matchmaking website and makes the acquaintance of a handsome gentleman, Tachibana, but… he works as a porn actor?! Despite her surprise, Mika attempts to show her understanding. "In that case, would you like to try it out?" Her body reacts when his fingers slip inside her. His professional technique is… incredibly good!!

She doesn't have any romantic stories even though she's the right age to get married, so her mother pressures her every day to meet men for an arranged marriage. 190482.description:
Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. The moment their eyes meet, Nick is hit with an overwhelming surge of pheromones. He knows instantly: Owen is his Omega. When terrorists launch a sudden attack on Owen, Nick steps in without hesitation. Grateful and intrigued, Owen invites Nick to his secluded estate. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he’s a “monster Omega,” ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He’s spent his life in strict control… until Nick’s bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses. As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn’t just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself. And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what’s his.

(Source: Lezhin US)

190483.description:
At just nine years old, Kiri leaves his sleepy village in the countryside and sets out to make a living for himself. With the help of a traveling merchant, Kiri reaches a bustling seaside town—where he’s betrayed and almost sold into slavery. He manages to escape, but now he’s all alone in the strange town with neither a roof over his head nor a coin in his pocket. The streets lead him to the Raging Kelpie’s Tail, a guild of adventurers. Its colorful characters take Kiri under their wing and watch over the earnest boy as he overcomes challenges and grows both in height and spirit.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

After a car accident, a young man awakes to find he’s in a new world. He’s taken on the persona of Roah Brestol, with a staggering magic stat that ensures he’s known far and wide. Any man has a chance to breed them, so long as they're willing to give up a percent of their future income for the rest of their lives. Here's hoping for a bright future!

190490.description:
To combat the drastic decline in the birth rate, a mad scientist scattered a virus into the air. Those affected by the virus experience a massive spike in their arousal levels and need to have sex with a compatible partner in order to clear the condition. Fortunately, there's a specialized course to help affected carriers get through it. It's certainly an interesting way to meet new people.

(Source: Fakku!)

His friends seem to think he’s living in a harem so he invites them over to learn the truth about just how bratty and spoiled the girls can be. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking. By improving the mercenary group's food situation and occasionally helping with inventions, Akari is gradually recognized by his fellow members of the mercenary group. However, Akari does not yet know that he himself will become a hero.

As the sister of the game's protagonist, she decides then and there that she's going to change the game by preventing her sister from being locked up by the crazy, obsessive male lead. She is determined to keep the two from meeting at all costs, but what is she supposed to do when said male lead suddenly turns up on her doorstep... as a gift from her father?!

(Source: Tapas)

Eleanor died from overworking as a teacher in her past life, so now she's determined not to work! She teaches her brother to be the prince's aide so he can be the breadwinner instead. When he reveals his sister is the true genius, she is asked to tutor the siblings of the most influential men in the land: her best friend, a handsome duke, and the crown prince. How can she refuse?! His job, Trapper, is seen as useless—after all, it lacks any offensive abilities. Stripped of his future as an adventurer, Keiichiro sinks into despair—until he encounters a mysterious girl who grants him a unique skill.

The skill, Arrow, shatters the limitations of a Trapper, transforming him into an unstoppable force. Determined to reclaim his place as an adventurer, Keiichiro embarks on a journey to become the strongest!

A voice in his head, calling itself "the Voice of Heaven," explains the path of his evolution, at the end of which the hero of the story will be able to become a dragon, gaining experience points and developing. The guy, having caught fire with this idea, begins hunting for the sake of raising the level. Who knew that magic, levels, and even special skills existed in this world?!
The hero begins his journey from the weakest to the strongest, starting with a small fish!

The village chief, who has taken notice of her, gives her an order. The order was to select Rama as the new “Demon King Candidate” from the Ogre village.

As lord of a thriving desert country, Seth is responsible for the prosperity and protection of his people... even if that means occasionally putting himself at risk. Fortunately, Seth's bodyguard, Kyle, is ready to yank his master out of harm's way... whether Seth likes it or not. In the decade since Seth bought him out of servitude, Kyle has become a dogged, dedicated (obsessive, overbearing) bodyguard, willing to sacrifice everything for the safety of his master. Seth, however, resents feeling caged by Kyle's constant controlling attentions... When Kyle finally crosses the line, will it be enough to capture his master's heart...?

But when love blooms, Ji-Heon lays down one unshakable truth: “I want to watch my lover with someone else.” Desperate not to lose the only person who’s ever truly seen him, Yeong-In agrees to a love that hurts—until pain and pleasure begin to blur. (Source: Lezhin US)

It’s been 10 years since she had a crush on her childhood friend. On the day that her childhood friend got engaged to another woman, Sylvia spent the night with her friend’s friend. “That day was definitely a mistake. But it shouldn’t have happened again.” “Why not? There’s nothing better than a kiss to comfort you.” He kissed her while lying on the grass. “You can use me in any way you want. I’m a good person, so I’m usually obedient.” “That’s not being good. It’s being spineless.” ‘Spineless.’ In fact, that’s something she didn’t have. Her heart, which she thought would never change even if she died, wavered after seeing a few affectionate and seductive words. “And then what if I really… like you?” Are we really… okay like this?

190633.description:
Mikado Hideo, who died in an accident, was reincarnated in another world as Lars Irving, the second son of a fallen aristocrat. Lars was not loved by his family in his previous life, but in this world he was doted on by his parents and older brother and lived happily. He was criticized for his “super jack-of-all-trades”, which he received at the age of 5, as a “missing skill”, but his family doesn’t care and lives a carefree life. One day, he learns that his father was a former feudal lord.
As he continued to investigate, Lars suspected that the current lord’s trap had ruined him, and he began to take action to return his parents to the lord. The “super jack-of-all-trades”, which was thought to be a lost skill, turned out to be a cheat skill, and Lars was embroiled in a big incident. The struggle of the ruined nobles who strive to solve the case with the failing skill “Super jack-of-all-trades” now begins!

Yeon-Woo’s love life has been nothing but a series of runaway men - all thanks to his freaky fetishes. But just when he’s about to give up, along comes Jae-Hyun: a perfect face, silky baritone voice, and fingers that look like they were sculpted by the gods. He’s everything Yeon-Woo’s ever dreamed of…and more. Determined to make Jae-Hyun his own, Yeon-Woo pulls his usual rich-guy schemes; but try as he might, Jae-Hyun remains totally unfazed. One drunken night, however, Jae-Hyun lets the truth slip: this handsome hung hunk hungers for someone who knows who take the lead. A guy who checks all his boxes and wants to be trained? 190667.description:
“Tonight... I wanted to be the one to make the first move.”

Kurata, a sharp and competent editor whose every project turns into a hit, is now living his dream—both professionally and personally—as the lover of the bestselling author he’s always admired, Enjouji Nao. Their days are filled with passion and fulfillment… but being desired night after night takes its toll. Eventually, even Kurata has to draw the line: “No weeknight sex!”
However, with an editor’s life where weekdays and weekends blur together, that self-imposed ban turns into a whole month of abstinence! Determined to break the dry spell tonight, Kurata ends up dozing off from exhaustion yet again. But with his patience running thin, he finally reaches his limit—and takes matters into his own hands…!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

190669.description:
Busy literary magazine editor Kaoru Yuzuki is living a semi-cohabiting life with his beloved son, Minoru, and his partner—bestselling author Taiga Kuroiwa.
Despite the daily struggles of dealing with Minoru’s full-blown “terrible twos,” life feels blissfully newlywed-like thanks to Taiga’s steady support.
But one day, a message arrives from Kaoru’s ex-wife—the very woman who left Minoru behind.
While Kaoru is filled with unease, Taiga is more determined than ever—he’ll never let go of Kaoru and Minoru again...!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

When Ki-Yool takes on an adult-themed music video, he tries to set the mood by experimenting with a toy, only to get caught in the act by Hyung himself! But instead of being shocked, Hyung unexpectedly offers to help him out. As the lines between fiction and reality begin to blur, both Ki-Yool and Hyung have to find the courage to step into the spotlight.

Ha-Ru runs away, but Do-Woon happens to become a visiting professor at his university. Do-Woon hires Ha-Ru as his secretary and the line between work and professional begins to blur. 190690.description:
Reina Takane, a first-year high school student, is so beautiful that people call her Takane-chan, the unattainable flower of the school. However, due to devoting all her free time to karate and schoolwork, she has trouble fitting in with the other girls in her class. On the day after summer vacation, an ordinarily inconspicuous girl, Kibon Hira, causes a fuss when she proclaims, "I hate it when other people give me cupcakes from home economics class." Because it's as if it's an unwanted love confession.

Yuri, the most popular girl in class, tries to tease Hira-san by pretending to confess to her. However, when her joke confession is dismissed out of hand, Yuri gets mad, and she blurts out another lie, that Takane-chan is the one who likes Hira. As a result, the two girls becomes linked in a relationship. From then on, Takane and Hira grow closer, as they run the relay at the sports festival, study together at the library, and perform in the class play at the cultural festival. Takane is drawn to Hira, who turns out to be kinder and more hardworking than she expected. On the other hand, she begins to worry about the fact that they became friends only through a false confession. And then, Yuri, jealous of their friendship, reveals Reina's mother's past in front of everyone in class.......

Wandering near a street corner, she encounters a man with rugged stubble, sharp eyebrows, and piercing eyes, staring at her intently. Su Wan makes a snap decision—she’s getting married anyway! "Becuase I have to save the world"

Kusunoki Masaomi confesses to her with a crazy nonsense reason.

Of course, the confession was not real. It was supposed to be a punishment game. And yet his lie was accepted.

Kika Hibari is a beautiful girl who is isolated from other people because of her talk about being the "savior" of the "spiritual world" and other strange topics.

But when he started going out with her, unlike the rumors, they can have normal conversations, and it turns out she can be honest and sweet...

Maybe she is just a cute girl? Masaomi found himself becoming serious about his feelings for her, but the more he learns about her, the more he realizes that her fantasies are "real," and she is not the only one involved―

"Masaomi-kun, do you believe my 'world' ?"

A little denpa love story where feelings that started as a lie become something more.

Our female lead had the martial arts skills to beat down any man, but never had the chance to date or even touch a man in her past life. After an untimely death, she is transmigrated into the childhood body of Iona, a noble lady in a Fantasy Romance novel world, where her fate is to wed and live with one man.

"No way! This time, I'm dating around!"

Determined to escape marriage, she befriends a crying boy she finds in her garden who shares a similar fate, and light-heartedly agrees to marry him to cheer him up. After Iona is all grown up and ready to mingle with all the gorgeous men in the empire, a certificate of engagement finds her, showing that she is already engaged to none other than Carvain Tenebreth, the ninth crown prince of the empire. The crying boy had scammed him into becoming his Crown Princess!

Iona, even running away from home, pushes for divorce, while her obsessive husband is hot on her tail, determined to wife her. Will Iona be able to enjoy a free love life, or end up tied to her obsessive prince for life?

Detective Kleine, assigned to the case, is ordered to investigate every detail under the guidance of the state’s special security division. His assigned partner? As Kleine is drawn deeper into the mystery, he comes face to face with Tristan, a man with unnatural powers and a disturbing connection to Agato. The deeper the investigation goes, the more it becomes clear: this isn't just a case about dead bodies. It's a collision of past sins, buried experiments, and a bond too dangerous to name.

190809.description:
Why, why is it always the black-haired guy who ends up as the male lead in romance fantasy novels? And why, why do I always fall for the brown-haired one?

Sub-male lead of Marriage Alliance: Baileon Biers. Childhood friend of the female lead, Princess Odette, and currently the Empire’s Chancellor. Naturally, he caught the eye of Reader No.1, who always falls for the brown-haired second lead.

How can a scholarly Chancellor possibly win against a cold-blooded, black-haired Northern Duke?! Every night, Reader No.1 cried out in despair— Only to suddenly find herself possessing the body of Marienne Didier, the Chancellor’s third aide in Marriage Alliance. Fine then! I’ll make my fave get his happy ending with my own hands! I’ll make Baileon the true male lead of Marriage Alliance!

"Ever thought about dyeing your hair? What do you think—black?"
"Why, all of a sudden, should I dye my hair black?"
"Because it’s the only way to end your long one-sided love, Sir Biers."

If hair color’s the problem, just dye it! If he lacks charisma, then we’ll practice! Operation: Act Like a Northern Bastard is a go. But.

"Walking away without looking back, speaking coldly while standing close... What even is this?"
"This is what will work on Her Highness the Fourth Princess."
"You’re saying Her Highness actually likes this kind of behavior?"
"Absolutely."
"This just makes me look like an overly aggressive jerk."

Though skeptical, Baileon goes along with Didier’s plan. But Odette remains unmoved, Baileon forces a bitter smile—And then the damn Northern Duke shows up. She may look like a soft cotton-candy bunny on the outside, But inside, Marienne Didier is a beast, dead-set on getting her favorite character his love story. Will she succeed?

Tae-Ha, who was barely making ends meet working as a delivery man, accidentally wins the lottery, but gets into a motorcycle accident on the way home and loses consciousness. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself as he was 10 years ago when he was a student, and to make matters worse, he finds himself in a dating simulation game... 'Find the target characters and increase their favorability ratings!' Will Tae-Ha be able to gain people's favor and return to reality?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

190812.description:
Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high school fighter of them all. At first, transfer student Ujae wants nothing to do with this, but he is soon dragged back into gang life to settle a score with the notorious Sunrise gang…

(Source: WEBTOON)

190813.description:
After saving little Amber from an abusive foster parent, hitman Tennessee gains someone worth protecting for the first time in his life. But the older Amber gets, the more his obsessive love for Tennessee grows, despite his rescuer still seeing him as the same little boy from years ago. It isn’t until Tennessee gets into an accident that leaves him with face blindness that the lines between them begin to blur. Tennessee knows in his head that this is still Amber, but his impairment makes both the younger man’s face and Tennessee’s own feelings for him unrecognizable...

(Source: Tappytoon)

190815.description:
For Yoo Jae-Min, debuting as an idol is everything, but his skills are outshined in particular by Jung Woo-Hyung. The other boy's laid-back attitude, especially toward their fans, irks Jae-Min, but their dynamic shifts when they become roommates and Woo-Hyung starts noticing cute sides to Jae-Min that he hadn't before. The fans notice this change and Jae-Min focuses all his attention on them and their love, which bothers Woo-Hyung. Will their group, 4ever, hit it big, or will Woo-Hyung and Jae-Min's tumultuous relationship lead to its downfall?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!

190816.description:
"Once you're in, the only way out is death!"

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he'd left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage. But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers. And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too. With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

(Source: Naver, translated)

190817.description:
Shin Hyuk, the Korean leader of the elite special forces unit "55," composed of the world's best black agents, is devastated when his younger sister, Soo Min, who dreamed of becoming an idol trainee, is murdered in South America. The world tries to cover up the truth. Abandoning everything to investigate his sister's death, Shin Hyuk uncovers that the international drug cartel "XICA" is a likely culprit. In pursuit of revenge, he deliberately approaches the global K-pop star Yoo Chae-won, whom they originally targeted, as her bodyguard. Ultimately, he plunges into Brazil's deadly favela, a land where even the gods have turned their backs...

(Source: Naver, translated)

190818.description:
Bul-Do Jeong was once a legend of the Korean underworld. But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the “MZ Gang” who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless. Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him. Now, it’s time the city remembered who ruled these streets.

(Source: WEBTOON)

190819.description:
"Alma mater, home town, blood ties—they're all but a façade!"

The war against organized crime waged by the government has failed miserably... and the world turned into a battlefield of mayhem ruled by one's fists. The one who unified this hell, Chairman of the Taejin Group, Jin Young-ui, has decided to open a competition of man, "Festival of Warriors" in search for a successor. Will our unemployed thug Kang Dae-oh rise to the top of the pyramid?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

190820.description:
Selected for the Olympic baseball team, Sae-Ram enters the athletes village only to reunite with his former youth teammate, Ji-Ho. Despite years of silence, they are assigned as roommates based on their history. Ji-Ho has always harbored a hidden interest in Sae-Ram and quickly seizes the opportunity. Under the guise of sports massages, his touch grows increasingly bold and intimate. Seeing a heated side of the man who once only teased him, Sae-Ram feels his heart begin to race. Is this just intense team bonding or the start of a dangerous game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

After his mother’s death, Gun-Woo moves in with his stepfather, Yi-Hyun—a man only fifteen years older, with whom he shares little more than a roof. Their relationship is distant, almost awkward, until Gun-Woo notices strange marks on Yi-Hyun’s body—too deliberate to ignore. A quiet curiosity takes root, and when he finds a vivid red rope hidden in Yi-Hyun’s room, he realizes there’s more to this man than he ever imagined.

The more he uncovers, the harder it is to look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

20-year-old Miyoko Hinata, also known as "Hiyoko," is a young pro golfer who ranked 108th in prize money last year, and is still looking for her first victory with help from her grandfather, Ginjiro. On the first day of the new tour season, she is paired with last year's top prize-winner, Erina Fraser. Will Hiyoko be able to fly towards her dream? 190826.description:
Straight-laced honor student Jin-Woo decides to break the rules just once, and steps into a club for the first time in his life. One drunken mistake leads to him spending a passionate night with a strikingly handsome stranger - the next morning, he wakes up alone in an empty room…with a pile of cash on the nightstand. Shocked and humiliated, Jin-Woo assumes the worst, and buries the memory deep in his heart. Back at school, Jin-Woo volunteers for a student performance…only to lock eyes with someone on stage. It’s him. The man from that night, and the king of campus: Kwon Tae-Yeong. It’s then that, in front of everyone and with a glint in his eye, Tae-Yeong smiles and utters two words that will change the course of both of their lives forever: “Found you.”

This led to him sharing a dinner table with Shizuka and Hiyori! Soma thought that's a dream come true, but as he spends more time with the girls, he sees more of their “true selves” and it's driving him crazy!

How can this be happening? This is a romantic comedy about living together with the “oshi” next door!

190844.description:
Why can’t my embarrassing past just disappear?!

“You’re always alone.” From the bottom of her heart, Yuffie Abisus desperately wants to be a saint for one reason only—so no one will ever say those aggravating words to her again. Fortunately for her, she’s been blessed with an extraordinary supply of mana despite being a commoner. Determined to succeed in her mission to become a saint and have everyone fawn over her, she enrolls in the Academy of Magic where she’s sure to free herself from her gloomy life. However, Yuffie has a secret. For whatever reason, she can only use attack magic, which itself falls strictly in the domain of men. Meaning she’s incapable of utilizing healing magic, women’s magic. Maybe that’s why she ends up being labeled a second-rate student and isolated from the rest of her cohort from day one.

So begins the tale of a girl who’s a smidge socially inept, disheartened by her struggle to make even a single friend, and once more mired in the drudgery of a loner life. A girl who, in spite of the challenges she faces, pushes herself ever onward to achieving her goal of sainthood!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

190851.description: Her powers may only heal skin-deep…but she’s determined to mend every wound with all her heart! Meet Sophie Olzon, the only daughter of a wealthy merchant family, cursed from birth with a mysterious skin condition. With her rough, bark-like appearance, Sophie has been cruelly nicknamed “The Monstrous Miss” by her peers and bullied relentlessly at school until she could bear no more. Forced into isolation, she retreats to her family estate and dedicates herself to mastering her peculiarly weak brand of magic that can only heal surface wounds. One fateful day, when Sophie nearly succumbs to the weight of her condition, a forgotten truth hits her—she once lived a life as a single mother in modern-day Japan! With renewed purpose, the Monstrous Miss opens her heart and doors to those seeking her unique brand of healing. (Source: Cross Infinite World)

A Fresh Start!

After coming home one day after working herself ragged, Olivia finds her engagement called off by her fiancé. What’s more, her adoptive sister claims Olivia’s jewelry designs as her own while Olivia’s adoptive family chases her out of her own home and store. Having lost everything, she tightly grips a letter of introduction her late father wrote and heads to the capital, all alone. There, she works hard and manages to start her own shop.

This is the story of a girl who hits rock bottom then climbs her way back to happiness through her own hard work, showing the people who took everything from her that she can’t be kept down.

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

A virgin protagonist with no experience with women registers on a dating app and ends up meeting his strict female homeroom teacher, Shizuka Nikaido?!

Due to the protagonist's straightforward and thoughtless intense advances, and the fear of their current relationship being exposed, Shizuka ends up having a relationship with him...

(Source: Fanza, translated)

Note: Originally Published as a four part doujin titled 'Katabutsu na Onna Kyoushi'

title.native: アプリでマッチングした相手は、堅物な担任女教師でした。

190871.description:
On Dahlia Belohr's first day as handmaiden, she simply receives one instruction: Whatever you do, do not, under any circumstances, go to the annex. But when an errand meant for another maid falls on her lap, Dahlia reluctantly finds herself walking through the very doors she was forbidden from entering and meets...him. The ghost of the annex. A permanent stain on the duke's legacy. The cursed bastard boy. What blooms is an unexpected connection that heals the pit of loneliness in both their hearts, despite the constant outside threats wanting to keep them apart.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Le Rêve Crépusculaire de la Servante

title.native: 下級メイドは公爵様の執愛から逃れられない
title.romaji: Kakyuu Maid wa Koushaku-sama no Shuai kara Nogarerarenai

190872.description:
Nicki is the daughter of the mafia that rules Noir City, a place riddled with vindictive ghosts. However, she has been confined at home due to her psychic ability that allows her to interact with these ghosts. Then one day, Teddy, a ghost possessing a teddy bear, comes to her house to recover the memories of its past. Teddy soon learns that Nicki’s father is involved with its death and that Nicki is at the center of his plans to solve the city's ghost urban legends. Thus, Teddy convinces Nicki to escape and bides the time to take away Nicki’s body for its own revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 魔靈召喚：超自然偵探妮琪

190873.description:
In war-torn Alea, there is endless destruction over the search of “Shelkrino,” a dangerous ancient artifact. Thus, Durand’s father Tomas, a member of the Sky Congress, kept a piece of Shelkrino hidden in his body for years. Eventually, evil comes knocking at their door and Tomas has to sacrifice himself to save both the artifact and Durand. Enraged by the death of his father, Durand takes the risk of awakening his abilities as a summoner by using Shelkrino. With this newfound power and the help of his comrades, Durand sets off on a path to avenge his parents and put an end to the war once and for all.

(Source: Tappytoon)

190874.description:
After an attempt to steal a magical relic goes very wrong, Eve not only loses a friend but also her freedom. She is forced to summon a monster and enter a fighting arena with other imprisoned slaves. Years go by, and Eve has finally honed her skills and plans to exact her revenge on the man who captured her when a group of sky pirates looking for relics suddenly appears. In that moment, she makes the choice to escape with the pirates on their ship and sets off on a tumultuous journey to find her true path in life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

190875.description:
One day, all the advertising posters in JR Shinjuku station were replaced with blanks! Who is the culprit behind this mysterious incident? Jiro Okazaki's science fiction mystery featuring the duo of Sena, a beautiful woman who can manipulate two-dimensional objects, and Udagawa, an ad man, is now available in a new edition.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

190876.description:
In order to defeat the Demon King... lose your virginity to your allies! The hero and his party finally reach the Demon King's castle. However, the Demon King's room is cursed with a curse that any virgin who enters will die... In order to defeat the Demon King, the virgin hero and his fellow heroines try various schemes to lose their virginity... The heroines are shocked by the hero's terrible behavior... or so you might think, but they are all in love with the hero...!? A high-tension love and brain battle romantic comedy woven by the worst hero and the cute and easy heroines!

(Source: Manga-Up; translated)

title.native: 童貞勇者は仲良くシたい

190877.description:
Byron Heiden, the eighth prince of the Lagon Kingdom, is ostracized for being an incompetent low-grade summoner. Consequently, he wastes his days fighting at a summoner gambling hall. However, as it turns out, Byron has been forced to hide his true powers from the public because he is the summoner of Russen the joker, a symbol of rebellion against the royal family. Despite knowing this, Taihan Heiden, the second prince, suddenly reappoints Byron as a successor of the throne and sets him on a mission to find the mysterious rebels that attacked the royal palace 11 years ago.

(Source: Tappytoon)

190878.description:
Since Gu Chenyi became entangled with Yi Ran, his daily routine became— “How can I get rid of this troublesome woman?” Recently he's been annoyed. The woman who craved to give him a child suddenly wants to do that for another man. Hehe, is it so hard to be honest these days? “You've cost me my marriage savings. How dare you seek to have a child with another man!?”

(Source: WebComics)

190879.description:
The monsters that poured out from the Rift of Worlds in Alea took everything from Ronnie. Since that day, he's been hellbent on getting revenge, slicing any monster that dared to stand in his way. One day, just as he is on the verge of death, Ronnie is rescued by trackers called Murray and Hayden and wakes up in a city called "Aden," a city of survivors. Though Murray and Hayden recommend Ronnie to become a tracker like them, he is still unsure. Will Ronnie be able to quench his thirst for revenge in Aden?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

190880.description:
The person I love will die.

At that time, I was in love. We only met alone twice. I hadn't told anyone yet, and our love had just begun. But then he was killed by someone. I don't think it was because I was in love with him, but...

I never thought that "falling in love" could make someone unhappy.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

190881.description:
The mountains in the south. The seas of the north. In between lies the known world, and the setting of our story. Please be patient, as we gradually unravel the mysteries surrounding the man known as Shanhaishi…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

190882.description:
A 60-year-old and a 14-year-old swap bodies!? A turbulent life revival story!

I, Furuta Tomiko, was told I had only one year left to live. Is my life full of regrets going to end like this? At that moment, a girl jumped in front of a truck and I saved her...!?

(Source: Office YOU, translated)

title.native: 余命1年、目覚めたらハイスペ家族の娘でした
title.romaji: Yomei 1-nen Mezametara High-spec Kazoku no Musume Deshita

190883.description:
Nagata Mariko is now divorced at the age of 40. She's returned to her parents' home, found a job, and life as a divorced woman is full of "firsts" and is busier than she expected. To be honest, she doesn't have any money, but there must be a way to be happy... right? And she'd also like to find love if possible! What awaits her in her second life at 40...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

190885.description:
Hyunwoo wakes up to find himself buried under a million-dollar debt. But there's a way out. If he agrees to become a literal 'dog,' he just might escape paying it back!

(Source: Toomics)

190886.description:
A hikikomori boy who died while dreaming of a harem was reborn as one of the heroes who will save the world. The harem he aimed for would surely be there!
Next to the hikikomori was someone reincarnated as the female white mage Fio, centering on the hero Alto. Fio is still crazy about girls even after her reincarnation, but the turning point comes when the party is split up by a surprise attack by the demon king's army and she and Alto take refuge in an abandoned hut.

In order to save Fio, Alto drinks a powerful potion that gives him temporary power but causes him to go into heat as a side effect...
Their relationship takes an unexpected turn! The gold standard of genderswap romantic comedy novels, featuring two people who were never meant to be in a relationship, has finally been translated into a full-color comic book!

title.native: TS転生してまさかのサブヒロインに。
title.romaji: TS Tensei Shite Masaka no Sub Heroine ni.

190887.description:
After being deceived by her boyfriend who she was about to marry, Koyoi decides to say goodbye to the world. But fortunately, she is found and saved by a strange man!! And Koyoi ends up helping him with his work...!?

Grace Oelin, plagued by a fear of sharp objects, faints whenever she meets Lucas Black, the kingdom’s most feared, sword-wielding duke. But beneath his cold exterior lies a hopeless romantic. Determined to break off their arranged marriage, Grace is horrified to learn Lucas has mistaken her fear for love. As he dreams of a sweet newlywed life, Grace plots her escape. Can she see past his fearsome image and discover who he truly is, or will the secrets of the infamous House Black pull her under?

190903.description:
Based on the original short story by novelist Kim Young-Ha, the first page of a tragedy entangled between three men and one woman begins. The webtoon's unique interpretation and writing style fills in the blanks that were not revealed in the original.

The first story, The Origin of Life, is Seo-Jin's first love, In-Ah, who appears like a miracle before his eyes. Surprisingly, she is the same as when she was a teenager. New truths are revealed in front of the love between the two people who seemed like they would last forever. "Seo-Jin, I'm married."

The second story, A Christmas Carol, is the death of 'Cho Jin-Sook', a Korean living in Germany who returned to Korea after 20 years. All three men surrounding her are murder suspects. The more you dig into the charred love between the four men and women, the more it heads toward destruction. What truth will be revealed at the end of these two stories that were reborn as webtoons?

(Source: Naver, translated)

After a drunken one-night stand with a stranger, Junseo blacks out, only to wake up in the home of a large, scarred man named Kang Wu-Jin.

“You don’t remember me?”

Something about Wu-Jin feels off, and Jun-Seo tries to run, but the man only smiles ominously.

“See you soon, Ha Jun-Seo.”

Days later, Wu-Jin reappears as Jun-Seo’s new boss. Trapped under his obsessive watch, Jun-Seo must figure out who Wu-Jin really is and whether escape is even possible.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a brief moment of confusion, Soo-Bin is troubled by Hee-Won's suggestion that the three of them play together... Will the three childhood friends be able to maintain their relationship safely?

Although he faced many dangers(?) while growing up, Su-Young, who kept her beliefs, falls in love at first sight with Ha-Joon at a party one day after returning to Korea. He didn't intend to, but when he came to him senses, Su-Young found out that Ha-Joon had stolen him first love. Just as he was thinking about not only dating Ha-Joon but also marriage and children, the next morning, he comes face to face with an empty bed next to him. So he goes to Ha-Joon's university entrance and confidently shouts... "Me! I ate it, so take responsibility!" But what happened? Ha-Joon cleanly refuses, saying that being a chaebol is not him taste. Being rich is not him taste? What the heck is wrong with your tastes?!?!!

With nowhere else to go, Yoontae ends up in the very life he tried to escape, trading sex for survival. He convinces himself love can be bought or borrowed, until an abusive relationship leaves him broken once more. When his ex attacks him in public, a stranger named Wooseok steps in. Is this the start of something real—or just another trap?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su-Bin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Ki-Hyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Ki-Hyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It’s a miracle, Su-Bin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Ki-Hyeok’s vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Su-Bin’s spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Su-Bin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world.

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Ki-Hyeok’s fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Su-Bin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As cities and towns expanded, supernatural beings learned to disguise themselves in human form. Sometimes they eat a human and cause a fuss in the news about supernatural incidents, but most of the time they lay low. So stories of evil youkai became extinct, and it is no longer necessary for celestial patrols. Earthly youkai know how to blend in, but sometimes there are troublemakers. Some celestial beings descend to the human realm, attracted by earthly temptations. And so the heavenly court must send spirit agents to capture and discipline them, before they cause too much damage…

Murdered in her previous life, she vowed to take double revenge on those who hurt her. But the past turns out to be more complicated than she thought. Did the cruelty against her actually have anything to do with the crown prince, or was it all just a conspiracy? How will they handle this love-hate relationship? Can they let go of the past to start anew?

(Source: INKR)

190958.description:
Accused of sins, Ying Tian and his tribe were imprisoned in the City of Sinners with collars that restricted their supernatural powers. However, Ying Tian was told that he was the descendant of a god. As Ying Tian was wondering about his true origins, disaster struck and destroyed the entire City of Sinners, leaving no survivors except for Ying Tian. Having escaped death, Ying Tian found himself free in the outside world, carrying the blood burden of revenge for his lost tribe. In order to find truth and justice, Ying Tian embarks on a new journey with new companions, as his godly powers awaken…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

190959.description:
This is a story about something that might happen to you or your loved ones. Case 1: An elderly woman living alone collapses in her home! After a devastating day, he returns home to find a drunken man laying on his doorstep? He takes a closer look and realizes this man was Kounoki, the president of his company!
Without a choice, he takes the drunken president in and looks after him. However, he eventually considers this to be a perfect opportunity for him! Sayama tries to collect information on Kounoki's weaknesses to get rid of his demonic boss's attitude by persuading the president, however…

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

However, as she starts to enjoy her life as a pampered “pet,” she begins to notice that her master’s affection may be crossing some boundaries. Her struggles to maintain her dignity while navigating this bizarre new world make for an intriguing and humorous story.

190970.description:

Though the person standing before him looks and acts exactly like Hikaru, Yoshiki knows that his friend is…gone. Someone—no, something has taken Hikaru’s place. And with so many eerie incidents happening in town lately, Yoshiki is becoming increasingly conflicted. Although things will never be as they once were, he would prefer this Hikaru to no Hikaru at all.

(Source: Yen Press)

190971.description:
In 16th century Europe, a witch helps her young apprentice escape a witch hunt and then disappears without a trace. Years later, in modern-day Japan, the apprentice finally tracks her down—only to find that the once-powerful witch is now a gloomy, apathetic woman who spends her days smoking by the window. What follows is a laid-back, offbeat comedy about the clash between a responsible apprentice and her completely unmotivated mentor.

“Go ask the witch to fuck you” — that was supposed to be a bullying punishment.

Under orders from the boy who led the aggressions, he visits the witch who lives on the outskirts of the village.

However, the witch delivers her body without hesitation and starts to seduce the young boy.

Moans, intertwined bodies, the pleasure of transgression — night after night, the young boy sinks deeper and deeper into his sexual relationship with the witch.

Meanwhile, another young boy observes motionlessly, in the middle of the darkness.

190989.description:
What's more tragic than a play by Shakespeare? As far as high school junior Juliet Holiday is concerned, her real tragedy is sharing a name with such a famous character. Then along comes a charming British transfer student named none other than Romeo. Did fate lead him to this small Kansas town? Pray tell, who's the real Romeo in Juliet's story?

190991.description:
Mod Note: Based on a Korean web novel, this was first published in English on POCKET COMICS (2024-01-02), but its first AniList-eligible publication was in Japanese by Comico (2024-01-13), and its Korean release was not until 2024-02-09 on Naver. Thus by AniList priority rules this is categorized as a Japanese manga.

Mirabel is a famed mercenary whose mother, Cornelia, had long suffered from the guilt of leaving her family, the Grand Dukedom of Criton behind. After Cornelia's failed attempts to contact her family left her distressed and led to her death, Mirable sought revenge, tracking down her grandfather, the Grand Duke Criton, and the assumed cause of all her mother's misery. After finding out that he too was betrayed, Mirabel meets an untimely death at the hands of the true culprit, only to wake up back when she was nine years old, with her mother still alive.

Determined to stop her mother's death, and seek revenge against the true villain, Mirabel sets out to make things right. But her choice to meet her grandfather makes her cross traces of her past, while she experiences a life she never knew before.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Helena, a novice sister working at the town church, harbors deep admiration for the beautiful and virtuous Lilia.

Recently, she's been puzzled by a subtle change in Lilia's demeanor.

The protagonist, Ivan, sets his sights on the unsuspecting Helena and uses his skills to attempt lewd contact.

At first, Helena serves without fully understanding, but gradually, she realizes that this is what brings happiness to Lilia.

The pure and innocent sister awakens to her instincts and begins to seek pleasure for herself...

While cleaning up the family Buddhist altar, Akari finds her great-grandmother's box. When she removes the double bottom, she finds an old marriage certificate and a wooden box. There is an unfamiliar name on the marriage certificate. It doesn't belong to her great-grandfather! Unable to wait any longer, Akari travels to Shikoku to investigate the mystery. Together with her distant relative Ryo, she gets closer to the secrets of her ancestors.

The story revolves around Jounouchi, Satou, and Maeda, three women who work as researchers, but have turned their back on femininity based on various excuses. However, they begin a special research project on "beauty." So begins the comedy-filled life of three women who try and fail at being feminine in a quest for self-evaluation.

Ivan, a humble laborer, admires Lilia, the lord's daughter. He lives a monotonous life, weary of daily work and his superiors, until a goddess's whim grants him the skill of "Lucky Lewdness."

"If I use this, can I see inside those clothes...?"
Thinking so, Ivan activates his skill on Lilia as they pass each other in the street.

Lilia, who got tangled up in the vines of a goddess statue at the church while trying to remove them, asks Ivan for help, only for him to take advantage of the situation.

Powerless against him, Lilia experiences insertion and her first climax, leaving her head and her v●gina in a melted, dazed state as she drowns in pleasure and falls into depravity.

Otaku manga artist Banana Nangoku has given birth! While raising her first child, her eldest daughter "Tantan," she soon becomes pregnant with her second child. Her second daughter, "Omochi," is born. But there is one big problem! Banana Nangoku is the oldest of several sisters, but she has no good memories of being "sisters." Thinking back from childhood to adulthood, all she remembers are verbal arguments with her younger sister, where they would exchange insults. So the author has decided to "have a happy sisters plan." It is finally about to begin ♪

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

190998.description:
Kaho Maeda and Shinichi Maki became close friends through their shared love of reading.
They were attracted to each other, but Kaho grew impatient with Maki, who didn't make a move to confess his feelings.
One day after school, Kaho returned to the school to retrieve a forgotten item.

There, she encountered Akira Kawashima, a notorious womanizer.
Kawashima, who had secretly been eyeing Kaho, learned of her feelings for Maki.
He forcibly kissed her and promised to delete the kiss photos if she had a relationship with him, to which Kaho reluctantly agreed.

Despite verbally resisting, Kaho's body reacted.

Hinata Kujo (39 years old) and her son, Toru, were in love with each other. Hinata knew it was wrong, but she spent her days in bliss. Hayato Sudo, Toru's homeroom teacher, became worried about Toru's increased absences.
He ended up witnessing Hinata and Toru having sex at their home.

Hayato, who had long harbored lust for Hinata's erotic face and her voluptuous, mature body, offered a deal in exchange for his silence about Hinata and Toru's relationship:
